events.title: Lazy Suzy Jazz Nights: June Edition
events.location: Lazy Suzy Coffee & Wine Bar, Woolloongabba
events.description: Enjoy intimate Monday-night jazz performances by a rotating trio of local musicians in a small, cozy neighbourhood wine bar. Bookings are recommended for tables after 7 PM.

events.title: Life Drawing at The Station
events.description: Participate in an unguided life drawing session featuring both clothed and nude models in a relaxed, social atmosphere within an artist-run warehouse space. Easels and boards are supplied; participants should bring their own drawing materials.

events.title: UQ Art Museum – Winter Exhibitions Late Opening
events.description: Explore current contemporary art exhibitions during this mid-week late opening, featuring insights from curators and student guides. Entry is free, but registration is recommended.

events.title: Brisbane Writers Workshop: Short Story Clinic
events.location: State Library of Queensland – Business Studio, South Brisbane
events.description: An intensive small-group workshop for emerging writers, focused on the structure, character development, and revision of short fiction. Led by a local published author, the clinic includes personalised feedback on a draft story.

events.title: Thursday Night Social Climbing
events.location: Urban Climb West End, West End
events.description: Join a community bouldering night featuring informal coaching, social games on the climbing wall, and post-climb drinks at a nearby bar. This event is suitable for both beginners and regular climbers.

events.title: Open Mic & Emerging Acts
events.location: Can You Keep A Secret?, Woolloongabba
events.description: Discover emerging indie, folk, and experimental artists at this eclectic open mic night held in a retro lounge bar with strictly limited capacity. Sign-ups for performers begin at 6:30 PM, with music starting at 7:30 PM.

events.title: Sea Shanty and Folk Song Session
events.description: Join a participatory sea shanty and traditional folk song singaround hosted by The Fo’c’sle, welcoming chorus singers and instrumentalists. Lyrics sheets are provided, and the bar will be open for refreshments.

events.title: Fluxus: Contemporary Painting in Brisbane
events.description: View a group exhibition of mid-career Brisbane painters showcasing works that explore colour and gesture. The event includes a Saturday afternoon artist floor talk followed by an informal Q&A session.

events.title: Saturday Morning Clay Taster
events.description: Get hands-on with clay in this introductory wheel and hand-building class held at a boutique ceramic studio. The session includes all clay materials, firing of a small piece, and coffee from the in-house café.

events.title: Contra & Folk Dance Social
events.location: New Farm Uniting Church Hall, New Farm
events.description: Join a lively community contra and bush dance featuring a live folk band and an experienced caller. No partner or prior experience is needed; just bring soft-soled shoes and a water bottle.

events.title: Sunday Jazz on the Green
events.location: Queensland Multicultural Centre Lawn, Kangaroo Point
events.description: Enjoy relaxed daytime jazz sets from local ensembles on the riverfront lawn, complete with food trucks and a picnic atmosphere. This family-friendly event encourages attendees to bring a rug and settle in.

events.title: Community Printmaking Induction
events.description: A small-group induction providing essential training for safe use of community print studio facilities, covering basic relief and etching processes. This workshop is required for future independent access to the studio.
